description: This PHP class defines a DataGroup object used in an installer utility for OrangeHRM. It encapsulates properties such as name, description, allowed permissions, and data group permissions, with methods for instantiation from an array and getters for its properties.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Represents a data group with attributes like name, description, allowed permission, and a list of data group permissions, mainly used for configuration or data management in the installer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataGroup with given name, description, allowed permission, and list of permissions.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DataGroup instance from a name and an associative array containing 'description', 'allowed', and 'permissions' data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data group.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the data group.

methods.name: getAllowed
methods.description: Returns the AllowedPermission object associated with the data group.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the array of DataGroupPermission objects associated with the data group.
